title: adenostemma viscosum var. parviflorum
intro: Adenostemma viscosum var. parviflorum, commonly known as sticky threadplant, is a plant species in the Acanthaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the Philippines, for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antihemorrhagic properties. The therapeutic actions of sticky threadplant include inhibiting platelet aggregation and reducing blood pressure, while its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, have been identified as responsible for its medicinal effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic applications of Adenostemma viscosum var. parviflorum.
